_meta.source: Fuel curve fitted by Wattlyst from manufacturer run-time specifications (petrol) and the industry approximate diesel fuel consumption chart (diesel); fuel prices from news reports of the Petroleum Division notification
_meta.method: Fuel use in litres per hour = intercept x rated kW + slope x load kW (the straight-line fuel curve used by HOMER microgrid software: no-load fuel per rated kW plus marginal fuel per kWh). Rated kW = generator kVA x the generator power factor (data/defaults.json pf_generator). Petrol: each source point is litres per hour at quarter load and at rated load from tank size / run time; both generators were normalised per rated kW and averaged, then the line through the two averaged points gives the coefficients. Diesel: the line through the quarter-load and full-load points of the chart (the same coefficients fit every size row of the chart within a few percent). Small generators sold in Pakistan vary; a worn or open-frame generator burns more. Engineer to confirm.
_meta.status: Planning estimates, not a measured figure for any one generator. Fuel prices change every few days in Pakistan (short-period pricing since 2026); refresh monthly and let the user enter today's price.
